newsitem.title: USA: Metrowerks sees Q2 revs topping $4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Metrowerks sees Q2 revs topping $4 mln.

text.p: Metrowerks Inc said on Monday that it expects its second quarter revenues for the period ended January 1997 to be between US$4.0 million to $4.5 million.
In last year's second quarter, the company reported revenues of $1.1 million.
Revenues ae expected to be more volatile and somewhat less predictable than in recent prior quarters because of non-recurring engineering contracts and new product sales, Metrowerks said.
